comment: The design of the joint and placement edit UI test (mitcad#1885, GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#354; tools/ui-joint-placement-edit-test.sh): Upright (C1, Upright:1 O1, its derived part F1), the test library's profile (LIBRARY_URL, replaced by the test) placed by BUILD standing at the origin, 500 long; Block (C2, Block:1 O2) with a 10 mm cube (F2.b0) joined by Cap joint (F3, rigid) onto the upright's end B mount frame with a frame override (its x turned to Y and its origin shifted 30 up: the cube from z = 530 to 540); Arm (C3, Arm:1 O3, its derived part F4, its slider joint F5), the same profile 200 long on the upright's y+ side, 100 past the side's middle (from z = 340 to 360). All geometry is synthetic.
